entity.name: products
entity.query: SELECT p.product_id as id, p.sku, p.model, p.price, p.selling_price, p.commission, p.is_single, p.status, p.quantity, p.sort_order, p.stock_status_id, p.date_available, p.date_added, p.minimum, p.viewed, p.piece_in_set, p.store_sales, p.exclusive, p.only_for_search, p.hsn_code as hsn_code, p.tax_class_id as tax_class_id, pd.name, pd.set_description, pd.description, pd.tag, ss.name AS stock_status, p.is_archived, p.rating, p.is_associate, IFNULL(p.franchise_id,0) as franchise_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT(pc.category_id) separator ',') as category_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT(cd.name) separator ',') as categories, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT(pf.filter_id) separator ',') as filter_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT(fd.name) separator ',') as filters, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT(p2s.store_id) separator ',') as store_id, IFNULL(oph.hotness_points,0) as hotness_value FROM oc_product AS p LEFT JOIN oc_product_description AS pd ON p.product_id = pd.product_id LEFT JOIN oc_stock_status AS ss ON ss.stock_status_id = p.stock_status_id LEFT JOIN oc_product_to_category AS pc ON pc.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN oc_category_description AS cd ON cd.category_id = pc.category_id LEFT JOIN oc_product_filter AS pf ON pf.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN oc_filter_description AS fd ON fd.filter_id = pf.filter_id LEFT JOIN oc_product_to_store AS p2s ON p2s.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN oc_product_hotness AS oph ON oph.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY p.product_id DESC
entity.deltaImportQuery: SELECT p.product_id as id, p.sku, p.model, p.price, p.selling_price, p.commission, p.is_single, p.status, p.quantity, p.sort_order, p.stock_status_id, p.date_available, p.date_added, p.minimum, p.viewed, p.piece_in_set, p.store_sales, p.exclusive, p.only_for_search, p.hsn_code as hsn_code, p.tax_class_id as tax_class_id, pd.name, pd.set_description, pd.description, pd.tag, ss.name AS stock_status, p.is_archived, p.rating, p.is_associate, IFNULL(p.franchise_id,0) as franchise_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT(pc.category_id) separator ',') as category_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT(cd.name) separator ',') as categories, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT(pf.filter_id) separator ',') as filter_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT(fd.name) separator ',') as filters, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT(p2s.store_id) separator ',') as store_id, IFNULL(oph.hotness_points,0) as hotness_value FROM oc_product AS p LEFT JOIN oc_product_description AS pd ON p.product_id = pd.product_id LEFT JOIN oc_stock_status AS ss ON ss.stock_status_id = p.stock_status_id LEFT JOIN oc_product_to_category AS pc ON pc.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN oc_category_description AS cd ON cd.category_id = pc.category_id LEFT JOIN oc_product_filter AS pf ON pf.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN oc_filter_description AS fd ON fd.filter_id = pf.filter_id LEFT JOIN oc_product_to_store AS p2s ON p2s.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN oc_product_hotness AS oph ON oph.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.product_id='${products.id}' GROUP BY p.product_id
entity.deltaQuery: SELECT p.product_id as id, p.hsn_code as hsn_code, p.date_modified FROM oc_product AS p WHERE p.date_modified > '${products.last_index_time}'

entity.name: filter_group
entity.query: SELECT pf.product_id, f.filter_group_id, GROUP_CONCAT(pf.filter_id SEPARATOR ',') as filter_ids FROM oc_product_filter pf INNER JOIN oc_filter f ON f.filter_id=pf.filter_id WHERE pf.product_id=${products.id} GROUP BY pf.product_id, f.filter_group_id

entity.name: special_price_data
entity.query: SELECT price as special_price, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(date_start,'+00:00','+01:00'),'%Y-%m-%dT%TZ') as date_start, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(date_end,'+00:00','+01:00'),'%Y-%m-%dT%TZ') as date_end FROM oc_product_special WHERE product_id = ${products.id}

entity.name: seller
entity.query: SELECT ms.seller_id, ms.nickname, ms.city, ms.seller_status, ms.vacation_mode, ms.app_only, ms.non_serviceable_areas FROM oc_ms_seller ms LEFT JOIN oc_ms_product mp ON mp.seller_id = ms.seller_id WHERE mp.product_id = ${products.id}
